progression.narrative: The performance opens on Fs3 and dwells most on Ek in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:11.5) introduces Ak, centred on Bk. Phrase 3 (0:22.5) introduces D, centred on Ak. Phrase 4 (0:33.4) introduces Fs, centred on Fs. Phrase 12 (2:18.2) introduces Ab, centred on Fs. Phrase 15 (2:48.2) introduces E, centred on D. The line peaks at Ak4 (416.9 Hz) at 0:44.4. It closes on Fs3, not the tonic (Ab4 → D4 → Fs4 → F4 → E4 → Fs3).
